title: refund.ready amount arrives as a string although its event contract declares number
actual: On current DEV a real refund.ready WebSocket event carried amount:"10.00" (JSON string). get_event('refund.ready') declares payload_fields.amount:'number', and the shared MCP convention says money is JSON numbers. This is not a client-created event: the native test observer copied fields from JSON.parse(raw) of the authenticated socket and preserved typeof string in its journal.
expected: Align refund.ready serialization with the documented numeric money field, or publish a deliberate revised event contract/generation and workflow guidance if strings are intended. Keep the REST ticket prompt amount and documented convention consistent. Frontend uses the event as a hint and re-reads the ticket; it does not invent/parse a replacement monetary state.
steps: Use a separately owned synthetic paid DEV ticket and request a partial refund; a different eligible actor approves it through POST /approvals/{request_id}/approve. Observe actual authenticated refund.ready. This reproduced once for synthetic ticket13/approval11/disbursement1. No new approval/dispensation is needed to inspect saved original event529. get_event('refund.ready') documents amount number.
